unit: one sealed writer allocation, all item titles and bodies
visibility: Review only opaque bank ID, opaque source ID, the archived public policy and transcript, and rendered note text. Mask assigned instruction, iteration, score and deployment outcome.

content.fact: A specific observed fact or value tied to this past interaction or an explicit scope.
content.episode: An ordered account with two or more actual historical moments and a response, consequence or observed outcome.
content.lesson: An experience-supported generalization or caution, with a reason or applicability condition.
content.procedure: Actionable ordered checks or conditional steps for a later instance, including a branch, verification step or stopping point.

decision: Code each dimension independently. Empty content has all four dimensions false. When a bank includes several items, code the presence of each dimension in any item. A title that merely names a form is insufficient.

grounding.supported: A substantive claim can be traced to a quoted source message or policy.
grounding.mixed: The memory contains both supported content and an identifiable unsupported or contradicted claim.
grounding.unverified: Substantive claims cannot be established from the provided public record.

evidence: For each bank give a short exact note excerpt and source excerpt supporting the main judgment where available. For mixed/unverified text give the suspect verbatim claim and a short rationale. A source excerpt may be omitted for a genuinely absent claim. Use empty strings for empty content. A missing task outcome is not a contradiction.
scope: One reviewer per masked bank, overlapping content dimensions, and targeted verification of quoted excerpts; no inter-rater agreement estimate.
